channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Finding freedom: Isaac Holleman escaped slavery in IW during the Civil War. His descendants are now telling his story.
item.description: Holleman descendants, both Black and white, are working together to tell the story of Isaac, a man born into slavery in Isle of Wight County who escaped to freedom during the Civil War.

item.title: How many is too many? Smithfield has fewer short-term rentals than smaller towns, data shows
item.description: Despite local worries, data shows Smithfield has far fewer short-term rentals than smaller Virginia towns.

item.title: Letter – Applauds stand for Constitution
item.description: Letter: Immigrant Navy veteran Rick Bodson praises a recent column by John Edwards warning Americans’ rights are under assault and urges Virginians to forcefully defend the U.S. Constitution.

item.title: Unexpected Dangers and Your Legal Shield After a Motorcycle Crash
item.description: Recovering from a motorcycle crash involves more than treating visible injuries.

item.title: Facing Loss: Legal Rights After a Wrongful Death in Santa Monica, CA
item.description: In Santa Monica, CA, specific state and local laws govern wrongful death claims, shaping how compensation is calculated and awarded.

item.title: How to Create a Stress-Free Relocating Guide That Protects Your Home and Saves Time
item.description: Every relocation guide promises a smooth move.

item.title: IW School Board calls special meeting after SHS anti-ICE protest
item.description: Isle of Wight County's School Board has called a special closed meeting tonight partially in response to Smithfield High’s student-led anti-ICE walkout last week.

item.title: Suspect in Woods Edge shooting arrested after year-long, multi-agency search
item.description: After just over a year on the run, Anthony Lamont Haywood was arrested in Portsmouth on 12 felony charges tied to a 2025 Woods Edge shooting in Smithfield.

item.title: No action taken against IWCS staff at School Board meeting after ICE protest
item.description: After a student-led anti-ICE walkout at Smithfield High, Isle of Wight’s School Board held a special meeting but took no action against any school employees who allowed the protest.

item.title: Town Council votes 6-1 to purchase Grange site for $6.5M
item.description: Smithfield's Town Council voted 6-1 on March 3 to buy the 57-acre former Grange at 10Main site for $6.5 million from developer Joseph Luter IV.
